# lifesim-lpao: unity_slot: clear stale Unity licensing helpers before starting Unity
task · P3 · auto, lane:platform

## Description
## Goal
Old Unity.Licensing.Client processes do not pile up across batch runs.

## Context
2026-10-24: 5 helpers ran at once (started Oct 18, 18, 19, 22, 24). Orphaned ones crashed 6 times on 10-23/24 (stack overflow in the helper's file-watcher setup, Unity 6000.7.0b4 beta). No run was hurt so far (checked 2026-10-24); this is cheap insurance. A healthy helper exits about 10 min after its last client leaves.

## Touches
tools/unity_slot.py, tools/tests/test_unity_slot.py

## Out of scope
Changing the Unity version.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Before launching Unity, unity_slot.py ends Unity.Licensing.Client processes older than 30 min while no Unity editor or batch process is running; it never touches a helper while any Unity runs.
2. A unit test covers both cases with a fake process list.
3. just check green.
